text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the April 16 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin was behind the controversial transfer of prize oil producer Purneftegaz to the state oil-giant Rosneft.
- A government hike in the price of strong alcohol is an attempt to freeze out bootleg distillers and increase budget revenues from vodka sales.
- The government is moving to improve the performance of investment funds which accumulated small investors' privatisation vouchers a couple of years ago.
- Giant Russian carrier Aeroflot is planning to start flying to a number of destinations inside the country to get ahead of foreign carriers trying to stake a place on the domestic market.
